page.overview:
What is Gildorf?

Gildorf is the more affluent district in Novigrad in , located in the north of city center and connected with Temple Isle via St. Gregory's Bridge.The place boasts the finest brothel in the area, bathhouse with thermal water, morgue, well, market with stalls, two shops and many residences.

It is inhabited by the free city's social elite - nobles, wealthy merchants, townspeople, ambassadors and alike. Because of its importance, the place is protected by Temple Guard and witch hunters. There are four entrances to the city's sewers. One of the steel swords, Gildorf sword, is named after this district.
